Class BackgroundExporter

java.lang.Object
tt.uwi.export.BackgroundExporter
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class BackgroundExporter extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Executes telemetry snapshot exports asynchronously and writes matching JSON and PDF files to a configured output directory.

  • Method Details

    • exportSnapshot

      public Future<?> exportSnapshot(TelemetrySession snapshot)
      Schedules asynchronous JSON and PDF exports for a completed snapshot. Both files use a shared timestamped, UUID-suffixed base name.
      Parameters:
      snapshot - the completed telemetry-session snapshot to export
      Returns:
      a future that completes after both export files are written
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the snapshot has no end time

    • close

      public void close()
      Shuts down the export worker and waits up to 30 seconds for pending exports to finish. An interruption restores the thread's interrupted status and is reported to standard error.
      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
